title: One-way slab strip
sentence: A one-way reinforced-concrete slab strip, pinned and rollered at its ends, under a uniform floor load.
theory: A simply supported strip under a uniform load $w$ carries $M_{max} = \dfrac{wL^2}{8}$ at mid-span and $\sigma = \dfrac{6M}{bh^2}$ in the extreme fibre. This is an elastic solid model: it says nothing about cracking or the reinforcement, which is what a code check (see the `eurocode-1992-check` skill) is for.
